sources.title: Leendert (Leen) Pot
sources.locator: Profile fields and narrative paragraphs on employment at N.V. Cemsto, resistance activity, 1943 escape, and liaison work in England
sources.rights_notes: Only short supporting excerpts and project-authored paraphrases are retained.

organizations.normalization_notes: The source wording N.V. Cemsto is preserved. No modern successor name is substituted.
Dutch wartime government service; retained separately from OSS, BBO, SOE, and SIS.

affiliations.date_precision: documented at the outbreak of the Second World War; later resistance activity began in 1942
affiliations.research_notes: The institutional profile places Pot at Cemsto when war began, then documents his resistance activity and 1943 escape. It does not state that Cemsto was his immediate predecessor to OSS service.

affiliations.date_precision: after arrival in England on 17 August 1943; exact sequence relative to OSS personnel status is not established
affiliations.research_notes: The source explicitly documents the liaison assignment but does not date Pot's entry into OSS. The assignment is not labeled an employer or an immediate pre-OSS role.

claims.claim_text: Museum Engelandvaarders' profile identifies indexed Captain Leendert Pot as the Dutch serviceman and resistance member known as Leen Pot.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare exact name, captain context, Dutch wartime service, and documented work with allied intelligence organizations identify the indexed person.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match using a distinctive full name and multiple compatible wartime identifiers.
claims.temporal_assessment: The profile traces his 1940 civilian work, 1942 resistance activity, 1943 escape, and subsequent liaison assignment.
claims.match_notes: The profile does not disclose a service number; exact OSS entry chronology still requires the Box 614 file.

claims.claim_text: At the outbreak of the Second World War, Leendert Pot was manager at N.V. Cemsto in The Hague; this is his last documented civilian employer before resistance and wartime liaison work.
claims.evidence_excerpt: is bedrijfsleider bij de NV Cemsto
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional profile places Pot as Cemsto's manager when war began and then traces his later resistance and wartime assignments.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence distinctive-name match to indexed Captain Leendert Pot.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last documented civilian role before his 1942 resistance activity; not labeled immediate pre-OSS.
claims.match_notes: No intervening civilian employer is documented, but the claim remains distinct from immediate OSS affiliation.
